parameters.content:
## LAYER 1: INGRESS & STANDARDIZATION
- Receives Return Approved webhook.
- Sends immediate HTTP 200 ACK to source app (prevents sender retries).
- Cleans and lowercases customer email strings.

## LAYER 2: CLASSIFICATION & EARLY EXIT
- Determines action: CANCEL (Full return) vs PAUSE (Partial return).
- Drops exchanges and non-refund items (NO_OP) to 'Log One-Time Return'.
- Prevents unnecessary Google Sheets & Recharge API queries.

## LAYER 3: IDEMPOTENCY & DEDUPLICATION
- Queries Dedup_Gate sheet for idempotency_key.
- If record exists -> routes to 'No Operation' (drops duplicate).
- If new -> appends 'processing' status record to Dedup_Gate.

## LAYER 4: RECHARGE STATE & MATCHING
- Fetches active subscriptions for customer email.
- Merges API response with normalized payload context.
- Code node filters array matching external_product_id.ecommerce to product ID.

## LAYER 5: MUTATION & AUDIT TELEMETRY
- Routes payload to Cancel or Pause Recharge endpoints.
- Appends success record to Google Sheets Audit Log.
- Updates Dedup_Gate record from 'processing' to 'Completed'.
- Error handling routes HTTP failures to Discord alert.
